benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~12 lakh (CEO, VP, CTO, CFO, Head of-, Director levels in 25K+ companies).

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: LinkedIn CPM for CXO targeting in India

calculationFlow: Indian CXO/senior decision-maker LinkedIn TAM: ~12 lakh (CEO, VP, CTO, CFO, Head of-, Director levels in 25K+ companies).
LinkedIn CPM for CXO targeting in India: ~₹400-600 (premium audience, very expensive).
Sponsored content impressions at ₹8L: 8L / 500 × 1,000 = 16 lakh impressions.
Frequency 3-4 → unique reach from sponsored content ~4-5 lakh.
Plus 5K InMail recipients (highly likely unique): ~5 lakh total unique CXO reach.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Penetration of TAM: ~40% of TAM saturated.
